changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led AI Visibility Analyst to Search Opportunity Mapper handoff, sample-level citations, pending setup and executable checks.

title: AI Visibility Intelligence
description: Turn a bounded, repeatable AI-answer citation sample into a sourced buyer-question opportunity, with owner review before any page change.
setup_prompt: Treat AI Visibility Intelligence as a proposal. Inspect my brand, approved buyer questions, answer-engine access and existing Crews. Propose reuse or creation of AI Visibility Analyst and Search Opportunity Mapper, a sample-level citation handoff, an owner-reviewed content decision and one manual test in Builder chat. Selection creates no Crew, engine run, page change, schedule or visibility claim.

setup_inputs.label: Canonical brand, aliases, competitors and approved question set
Answer engines, locale, surface, session mode, run count and capture limits
Canonical site and authorized existing-page inspection scope
Brand mention, direct citation, unknown and failed-run classification
Owner, content review and repeat-sample decision rule
Manual only or proposed recurrence with timezone and budget

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create an approved missing specialist with a stable idempotency key and Workflow-bound Crew step

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass the validated citation snapshot through a checked Workflow alias

recommended_tools.name: AI visibility tracker CLI or MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Run versioned questions on authorized answer-engine surfaces and retain response and citation provenance

recommended_tools.name: Approved browser or answer source
recommended_tools.purpose: Capture bounded answer runs, cited URLs, errors, timestamps and surface limitations

recommended_tools.name: Approved site browser or crawl
recommended_tools.purpose: Inspect the exact page proposed for a useful answer improvement

recommended_tools.name: Google Search Console MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Add authorized search context without equating it to AI-answer citation counts

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether visibility insight explains AI-search presence outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Reviewed two-Crew roster and sample policy
Validated answer-level citation snapshot with observed and failed runs separated
Exact-question opportunity with an inspected page and owner decision
Manual run proof and paused repeat-sampling choice
